selection.edition: caller-supplied Bark server (api.day.app default plus self-hosted extra field)
selection.ownership: Independent open-source Bark iOS app and bark-server by GitHub user Finb. Official public push host is api.day.app. Self-hosted bark-server is a first-class extraFields.baseUrl. Chinese-language-first docs with English translation; global App Store distribution. Not a mainland-China exclusive edition. Public-server operator is not a documented corporation.

research.searchCoverage: Official Bark tutorial and bark-server API V2 (POST /push, GET /ping, GET /info), optional self-hosted Server Base URL extra field, default https://api.day.app, Finb/Bark GitHub identity, and dated incident search for Bark iOS / bark-server / api.day.app / day.app security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Distinct from bark.com parental-control and bark.com marketplace products. Pinned OpenConnector accepts an arbitrary HTTPS baseUrl for self-hosted bark-server. No Algolia-style required stored id plus bounded wildcard covers official api.day.app together with caller-owned hosts. GET /ping and GET /info do not send the device key; POST /push is a write. This is not a breach-free claim.
